info.title: Web Research Analyst API
info.description: CrewAI Web Research Analyst: scrapes a web page with Firecrawl and summarizes it. Upload this file in Azure portal > Web App > AI (preview) > MCP servers > Create MCP server. App Service built-in MCP needs OpenAPI 3.0.x; FastAPI's /openapi.json is 3.1, so this file is maintained by hand.

post.summary: Scrape a web page and return a plain-language summary
post.description: Runs the CrewAI Web Research Analyst agent: it scrapes the given URL with Firecrawl and returns a short report with a one-sentence description, 3 to 5 key points, and any notable links or calls to action. A run can take a minute or more.

url.description: Full URL of the page to summarize, for example https://www.firecrawl.dev
